Vendored, unmodified, so the UI needs no build step or package manager.

- `preact-htm.js`: `htm@3.1.1/preact/standalone.module.js` (Preact 10 + htm). Licences: `LICENSE-preact` (MIT), `LICENSE-htm` (Apache-2.0).
- `mermaid.min.js`: `mermaid@12.2.0/dist/mermaid.min.js`, loaded on demand by the artifacts panel. Licence: `LICENSE-mermaid` (MIT).
